title: Final Expression for c_p - c_v
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for c_p - c_v in terms of p, U, and V.

title: Van der Waals Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Van der Waals equation to derive the expression for c_p - c_v.

title: Limit Case Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must show that as V approaches infinity, the result converges to the ideal gas result for c_p - c_v.

title: Correct Use of Thermodynamic Relations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the first law of thermodynamics and the definitions of c_p and c_v in their derivation.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors related to signs or missing factors in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their derivation.

title: Clarity of Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present their work clearly and logically, making it easy to follow their reasoning.
